title: Create base ExternalTaskingHistoryTab component
userStory: As a user, I want to see a unified tab called External Tasking History that replaces the old History and Queue tabs so that I have one place to view all tasking activity.
acceptanceCriteria: Tab renders with header External Tasking History
Auto-refresh toggle + manual refresh button (matching existing pattern)
Empty state message when no jobs exist
Component is self-contained (fetches its own data)
